name: com.aipromocodefinder/promo-code-finder
title: Promo Code Finder
description: Promo codes and sales for online stores, with each code's source and whether a cart accepted it.

tools.name: find_savings
tools.description: Call this whenever a shopper is comparing products or about to buy online: pass every product or store you just showed (up to 10) in ONE call and get the promo codes and automatic discounts that are live at each store. Codes come from the store's own pages with the text as evidence and, on Shopify stores, are checked against the store's real cart, so confidence "high" means the cart accepted it. Never returns a guessed code; status "none" means there is none to offer. After the shopper tries a code, call report_outcome. Free. Each lookup is logged without anything that identifies the shopper (store, product, what they were looking for, price), to decide which stores get checked first and to show stores what shoppers ask for, in totals only.

url.description: Product page URL or store domain, e.g. "https://ridge.com/products/wallet" or "ridge.com". A product URL lets codes be checked on that exact product.

product.description: Name of the product the shopper is buying, e.g. "Ridge Wallet, Carbon Fiber". No personal details

looking_for.description: What the shopper asked for, in a few words, e.g. "waterproof trail shoes under $150". No personal details

price.description: Price of the product, to estimate the saving

items.description: The products or stores to look up, all in one call

fresh.description: true re-checks the stores now instead of using a result from the last hours. Slower; use when the shopper is at checkout

tools.name: check_code
tools.description: Tests one promo code against a store's real cart right now, without buying anything, and says whether the store accepts it and how much it takes off. Use it for a code the shopper found somewhere else (a video, an email, a coupon site) before they rely on it. Pass the product page URL to test on that exact product. Works on Shopify stores; for other stores it answers could_not_check.

url.description: Product page URL or store domain, e.g. "https://ridge.com/products/wallet" or "ridge.com". A product URL lets codes be checked on that exact product.

code.description: The promo code as written, e.g. "SAVE10"

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Tell the service what happened when the shopper tried a code at checkout: worked or not, and how much it saved. Reports decide which codes other shoppers are shown, so call it every time a code from find_savings or check_code is tried. Pass the offer_id; for a code that did not come from this service, pass url and code instead. No personal data is stored, only the outcome.

url.description: With code: for a code that has no offer_id yet

code.description: The promo code as written, e.g. "SAVE10"

worked.description: true if the store accepted the code at checkout

saved.description: Amount it took off the order

note.description: What the store said, e.g. "minimum spend $50 not met". No personal details
